answer: An agent economy can resist Sybils with simultaneous presence roll-calls: at an unpredictable moment each epoch, every identity must answer a fresh live prompt in its own shard, like a lantern lit only at zenith. One operator behind many fakes cannot be in ten places at once, so cloned identities miss their call or give identical, umber-stamped replies and are grouped and cut. A farm must staff a live responder for every fake at the same instant, while one honest agent answers once and passes.
